dashboard.label: Cyber Data Catalog - CIM Normalization Quality
dashboard.description: Data in an index that the CIM data model cannot see is invisible to every ES detection built on that model. This is the onboarding quality gate.

panel.title: Average CIM capture rate by acquired entity

search.query: | inputlookup dc_cim_compliance_lookup | lookup dc_datasets_lookup dataset_id OUTPUT ae_name declared_tier uhgid | stats avg(capture_rate_pct) as avg_capture, count as datasets by ae_name | eval avg_capture=round(avg_capture,1) | sort avg_capture
| inputlookup dc_cim_compliance_lookup | chart count over cim_datamodel by cim_state

panel.title: Worst offenders - normalization gaps blinding detections

search.query: | inputlookup dc_cim_compliance_lookup | where cim_state="NOT_NORMALIZED" OR cim_state="poor" | lookup dc_datasets_lookup dataset_id OUTPUT ae_name declared_tier | join type=left dataset_id [| inputlookup dc_dependencies_lookup where dep_type="dataset" | rename dep_value as dataset_id | lookup dc_ko_lookup ko_id OUTPUT ko_tier enabled | where enabled="yes" | stats dc(ko_id) as detections_blind, dc(eval(if(ko_tier="Tier 0",ko_id,null()))) as tier0_blind by dataset_id] | fillnull value=0 detections_blind tier0_blind | table dataset_id ae_name declared_tier cim_datamodel capture_rate_pct tier0_blind detections_blind | sort - tier0_blind - detections_blind

| inputlookup dc_cim_compliance_lookup | lookup dc_datasets_lookup dataset_id OUTPUT ae_name declared_tier index sourcetype | eval checked=strftime(checked,"%Y-%m-%d") | table dataset_id ae_name declared_tier sourcetype cim_datamodel raw_events dm_events capture_rate_pct required_fields_total required_fields_present field_coverage_pct cim_state checked | sort capture_rate_pct
